paragraphs: R' Yosi Zuta. Mentioned in the Zohar, Va’era 29a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Va’era 29a follows כט. under the period convention. This interprets Hyman’s locator; no named Zohar edition is specified or independently checked.
Zuta is preserved as the supplied epithet without identifying another person named Yosi. The abbreviated title remains R'.
